(i) the proposed parallel MCMC method is efficient for sampling in high-dimensional problems and robust with respect to the initial conditions; and (ii) the proposed parallel simulated annealing algorithm is competitive with the state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of computational cost and robustness.
we introduce a novel parallel MCMC algorithm that is able to improve the efficiency of sampling and optimization, and we show that this new algorithm is more robust than the state of the art.
we propose a novel parallel MCMC sampling scheme, which is able to combine local approximation with global exploration, and we provide an efficient implementation of the proposed scheme.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of novel parallel MCMC techniques, which are able to combine the benefits of global exploration and fast local approximation, in order to improve both the efficiency and the robustness of sampling and optimization algorithms.
the design and analysis of new algorithms to solve problems of sampling and optimization in high-dimensional spaces.
the development and analysis of new parallel interacting Monte Carlo (MC)-based schemes for sampling and optimization in statistics and machine learning.

the O-MCMC method is an effective and robust parallel MCMC method for Bayesian sampling and optimization.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
O-MCMC is a new class of parallel MCMC schemes, where vertical chains are led with random walk proposals and horizontal chains are led by independent proposals.
O-MCMC is a novel sampling scheme which combines global exploration with local approximation.
we propose a new class of parallel interacting MCMCs that combines global exploration and local adaptation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the problem of interest, a combination of random walk MCMC and independent proposals can be more effective than a combination of independent proposals and random walk proposals.
the proposed O-MCMC method is an efficient and easy to implement sampling scheme, which can be used in many applications, specially in those problems where the state space has high dimensionality.
O-MCMC can be used to sample from the posterior distribution of Bayesian hierarchical models.
